    Maria Laura Flores Barba

    she/her

    I am an art historian and digital humanist whose research bridges visual culture, material studies, and community-based memory work. My postdoctoral project, Rebuilding Memory, Shaping Futures, explores how testimony, mapping, and digital tools can foster historical justice, intergenerational dialogue, and collective healing in postwar El Salvador.
